title: Как зубы почистить  (Like Brushing Your Teeth)

segments.t: In the kitchen of Arcobaleno, Chef Barinov cannot stop worrying about his impulsive night with young waitress Eva, pointing out that he drank cognac five years older than she is. Trying to calm his boss, sous-chef Lyova claims that for today's youth, sleeping together is no big deal—just like brushing one's teeth.
Шеф, ну не расстраивайтесь вы так сильно!
Всё в порядке, Ева уже взрослая девушка.
Лёва, я вчера пил очень старый коньяк!
Этот коньяк на пять лет старше её!
Она же мне в младшие дочери годится!
Виктор Петрович, относитесь к этому намного проще.
У нынешней молодёжи сейчас совсем другие взгляды.
Для них это просто как зубы почистить!
Никто не придаёт этому большого значения.
Тоже мне, нашёлся большой знаток современной жизни!
Не говори мне такой ерунды, Лёва!
Я просто хотел вас немного успокоить, шеф.
Let's walk through Chef Barinov's worries and Lyova's dubious relationship advice.

'Chef, well do not get so upset like that!' Lyova declares that do not get so upset like as the tension in the room peaks. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
Всё в порядке, Ева уже взрослая девушка.
'Everything is fine, Eva is already a grown young woman.' Once everything is fine Eva is already a grown young woman, Lyova can finally tell Barinov what he means.
Лёва, я вчера пил очень старый коньяк!
'Lyova, yesterday I drank very old cognac!' Insisting that yesterday he drank very old cognac shows Barinov is not backing down.
Этот коньяк на пять лет старше её!

'That cognac is five years older than her!' Once that cognac is five years older than, Barinov makes sure Lyova hears every word. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Она же мне в младшие дочери годится!

'She is young enough to be my younger daughter!' Declaring that she is young enough to be his younger daughter brings Barinov's temper right to the surface. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Виктор Петрович, относитесь к этому намного проще.
'Viktor Petrovich, take this much more lightly.' By telling Barinov to take this much more lightly, Lyova keeps his side of the story grounded.
У нынешней молодёжи сейчас совсем другие взгляды.
'Today's youth have completely different views now.' Lyova reminds Barinov that today youth have completely different views now before the moment passes.
Для них это просто как зубы почистить!

'For them it is simply like brushing their teeth!' Lyova declares that for them it is simply like brushing their teeth as the tension in the room peaks. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Никто не придаёт этому большого значения.
'Nobody attaches great importance to this.' With the moment and calm in play, Lyova keeps this short reply brisk and direct.

'Some great expert on modern life you turned out to be!' Insisting that some great expert on modern life Lyova turned out to be shows Barinov is not backing down. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.

'Do not talk such nonsense to me, Lyova!' Once do not talk such nonsense to him, Barinov makes sure Lyova hears every word. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
